clips.title: The story
paras: In Brill, Magistrate Sevren directs the settlement's defense and sends newcomers to steady the lands around the Undercity.

From Brill's town hall, Magistrate Sevren directs civil and strategic affairs in the lands north of the Undercity. New Forsaken arriving in Tirisfal Glades find local crises waiting. Sevren sends adventurers to restore order, secure ruined places, and suppress threats in the surrounding hills.

The Tirisfal dead and their burial grounds are among Magistrate Sevren's chief concerns. Scourge-aligned Rot Hide gnolls, graverobbers, and rogue undead threaten the graves and Sylvanas Windrunner's growing dominion. Sevren seeks to reclaim ancestral tombs such as the Agamand Family Crypt and keep deserters or uncooperative forces from undermining Forsaken authority.
